tabs.tab_content: Reviews and referrals are among the strongest signals Google and AI search use to recommend local businesses, and every referral is a new person discovering you. That’s why the framework is a loop, not a line.

tabs.tab_title: Is it OK to ask for reviews?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, as long as you ask every customer and don’t offer rewards for reviews. We keep everything within Google’s guidelines.

tabs.tab_title: What kind of loyalty program fits a service business?
tabs.tab_content: Maintenance plans, priority booking and member pricing work especially well. We design around how your customers already buy.

tabs.tab_title: How soon will we see more reviews?
tabs.tab_content: Most businesses see new reviews within the first week of automated requests, and steady growth from there.

tabs.tab_title: Can I hire you for just this stage?
tabs.tab_content: Every partnership covers the full framework, with priorities set around your weakest stage. If FirstReferral is where you’re losing customers, that’s where your plan starts. Prefer to work on it yourself? The FirstReferral module in the BeFirst Community covers it step by step.
